assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The service is clinically indicated for this presentation.
The service is necessary given the documented recurrent syncope and palpitations requiring arrhythmia correlation in the context of atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
